scientific_integrity: Strict positivity is supported by a complete exact integer polynomial coefficient table, a standard-library verifier, and independent SymPy reconstruction. No claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the homogeneous scalar test equation and fixed positive four-periodic grids; no claim for arbitrary step sequences, forced stability, global convergence or uniform constants as ratios degenerate. The date is for a publicly dated author-uploaded copy of a 1990 article, not the original paper date.
title: Unrestricted four-periodic zero stability of variable-step BDF3
